messages:
zoe: Heads-up 1 I'm opening a small docs PR: clarify Optimize toolkit behavior for KV prefetch + short-sequence batching, add a compact Rust example and a tiny Python snippet for quick testing. Also there's a stale link in the sidebar to /optimize/cache that 404s.

sam: 👍 can you add a short note about when to disable kv_prefetch? We've seen people get higher latency on long-input cases.

zoe: plan: keep default kv_prefetch=true, but note: set kv_prefetch=false for seq_len > 1024 or when using large-batch modes. I'll add a short table of recommended settings by seq_len.

liam: can you include a quant-profile example showing mixed precision for attention vs kv cache? support will ask about accuracy tradeoffs.

zoe: adding this sample JSON profile: 
```json
{"name":"opt-shortseq-mixed","default_dtype":"int8","layer_overrides":{"attention":"int8","kv_cache":"fp16"},"intended_seq":"<=128","note":"balances mem and stability"}
```

noa: for the Rust snippet make it tiny and runnable in play.rust-lang.org style. We should show enabling batching header and a call to Generate.

zoe: draft Rust snippet: 
```rust
use redwood_rs::Client;\nfn main(){\n  let client = Client::new("$REDWOOD_KEY");\n  let resp = client.generate("redwood-opt-1", "Summarize this:", 48, Some("batching=enabled"));\n  println!("{}", resp.text);\n}
```

sam: small nit: the Rust SDK arg shape is (model, prompt, max_tokens, opts). opts should be an options struct, but keep the snippet illustrative. Add a one-line comment pointing to full SDK examples.

zoe: done. Added comment: "// see SDK docs for full options struct". Also added Python snippet for quick copy: 
```python
from redwood import Redwood
c = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
print(c.generate(model="redwood-opt-1", prompt="TL;DR", max_tokens=40))
```

docs-bot: @zoe created PR #4571: "optkit: kv-prefetch + shortseq notes; add Rust/Python snippets; fix sidebar link"  CI queued.

liam: I'll review the quant profile wording. Suggest changing "balances mem and stability" to "may reduce memory and keep accuracy for short inputs; verify on your eval set".

zoe: updated note wording per liam. Pushed changes.

docs-bot: CI checks: link-check  failed on /optimize/cache -> 404; sample lints  warning (Rust sample uses illustrative opts), markdown lint  passed.

sam: I fixed the sidebar config in a quick commit, pointing /optimize/cache -> /optimize/caching.

zoe: thanks 1 re-running. Also added a tiny migration-changelog paragraph: "optkit: clarified kv_prefetch guidance; added shortseq recipes and Rust/Python snippets; fixed caching link."

docs-bot: CI passed after fixes  samples-built  link-check .

noa: small UX ask: can we add a one-liner near the Rust snippet about recommended batch_size for seq_len<=128 (4-12) and a pointer to Console toggles? People repeatedly ask.

zoe: added: "recommended batch_size: 4-12 for seq_len <= 128; enable batching in Console -> Model routes -> Batching."

liam: perfect. I'll merge once staging preview looks good (10m). If support flags uptick on quant regressions, route to liam for triage.

zoe: merging after smoke check. Thanks all for quick turns.
